iot_bronze.matter_events.ddl:
CREATE TABLE tfm.iot_bronze.matter_events (
   event_id varchar,
   source varchar,
   entity_id varchar,
   domain varchar,
   state varchar,
   unit varchar,
   device_class varchar,
   area_id varchar,
   friendly_name varchar,
   attributes_json varchar,
   event_timestamp varchar,
   updated_timestamp varchar,
   ingestion_timestamp varchar,
   bridge_timestamp varchar,
   mqtt_topic varchar,
   quality_status varchar,
   quality_flag varchar,
   quality_rules_version varchar,
   quality_config varchar,
   schema_version integer,
   numeric_state double,
   attributes map(varchar, varchar),
   quality_errors array(varchar),
   quality_warnings array(varchar),
   event_time timestamp(6) with time zone,
   updated_time timestamp(6) with time zone,
   ingestion_time timestamp(6) with time zone,
   bridge_time timestamp(6) with time zone,
   observation_id varchar,
   entity_key varchar,
   raw_value varchar,
   kafka_topic varchar,
   kafka_partition integer,
   kafka_offset bigint,
   kafka_timestamp timestamp(6) with time zone,
   bronze_timestamp timestamp(6) with time zone,
   processing_time timestamp(6) with time zone,
   event_date date
)
WITH (
   compression_codec = 'ZSTD',
   format = 'PARQUET',
   format_version = 2,
   location = 's3a://tfm-lakehouse/iot_bronze/matter_events',
   partitioning = ARRAY['day(kafka_timestamp)']
)
